name: Mana value
description: A number determined by the total amount of mana in an object's mana cost; formerly called casting cost and converted mana cost.

description_citations.text: "Mana value". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Before Sixth Edition the concept was called casting cost; the Sixth Edition rules changes renamed it converted mana cost.
timeline.quote: With the Sixth Edition rules changes , "casting cost" became "converted mana cost"

citation.text: "Mana value", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The term mana value is introduced in Strixhaven: School of Mages and older cards are updated.
timeline.quote: The term "mana value" was introduced in Strixhaven: School of Mages .

citation.text: "Mana value", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Scourge's Cost matters theme encourages spells with high mana values.
timeline.quote: "Cost matters" was a theme in Scourge
